phase_title: Production Protected-Presentation Registration Continuation Against Existing Generation-1 Deployment State

attempt_1.result: FAILED before any PAWA capability was issued or consumed (production_writer() raised prior to handle.consume()/store.apply_configuration())
attempt_1.error: PAWA recognition/issuance refused: protected_root_untrusted: indeterminate permissions: acl_inspection_unavailable (ancestor_indeterminate for /, /Library, /Library/Application Support, .../PCAE, .../HPAC)
attempt_1.root_cause: the human operator's interactive shell PATH contains several uid-501-writable directories (~/.kimi-code/bin, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, etc.) preceding /usr/bin and /bin, so pcae.core.hatp_class_b_topology_verifier._resolve_trusted_executable_for_subject('ls', ...) correctly, conservatively, refuses to trust ls for the ACL check -- never a false pass, fail-closed as designed. NOT a product defect.
attempt_1.classification: NO-WRITE FAILURE (safe, clean; verified no durable artifact appeared before or after)

attempt_1_root_cause_confirmation.method: unprivileged, read-only reproduction of _resolve_trusted_executable_for_subject('ls', uid=501, gids=<atilamadai groups>) with the operator's real PATH -> returns None (untrusted); reproduced identically with a sanitized PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin -> resolves /bin/ls

attempt_2.result: FAILED -- ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pcae' (the sanitized PATH resolved /usr/bin/python3, Apple's system interpreter, which does not see the editable-install .pth entry that adds src/ to sys.path)
attempt_2.classification: NO-WRITE FAILURE (failed at import time, before any pcae code executed)

attempt_3_successful.fix_rationale: PATH stayed minimal/system-only for the internal ls/getfacl trust check (fixing attempt_1's cause); the python interpreter was instead given as a full, explicit path to the homebrew interpreter that has the editable pcae install on sys.path (fixing attempt_2's cause). Neither change widens any authority or touches product source.
attempt_3_successful.authentication_mechanism: sudo password prompt in the operator's own terminal -- entered by the human directly, never seen, echoed, logged, or persisted by this session

post_registration_readback.false_positive_note: an ad hoc read-back script's direct call to ProtectedPresentationInstallationStore.resolve_current_generation() via a freshly-constructed, UNBOUND HPACStoreAuthority.production() raised ProtectedPresentationIntegrityError('production HPAC root is not protected from the configured agent principal (root=agent_is_owner_with_write_bit ...)'). Root-caused: hpac_foundation.HPACStoreAuthority._validate_production_boundary falls back to the LIVE PROCESS identity (root, since the script was run via sudo) whenever _configured_agent_identity has not been bound by the PAWA writer factory's SS33 recognition sequence (which the ad hoc script never invoked). Root legitimately owns the root directory it provisioned, so the mode check trivially reports 'agent_is_owner_with_write_bit' for uid 0 == uid 0 -- this is an artifact of the diagnostic script's improper API usage, not a defect in the registration transaction or in the actual topology, which the raw ownership/mode readback (root_anchor block above) independently confirms is correctly protected from the real configured agent (uid 501). No source change was made or is proposed to address this; it is documented here as an observed API-usage pitfall for future read-only diagnostics, not adjudicated as a product defect this phase (no src/pcae change occurred).
post_registration_readback.capability_consumption: the single bounded configure_presentation_mechanism transaction consumed its one-shot capability inside apply_configuration(); a fresh call would mint a new transaction_id/capability rather than reuse this one (structural, non-reusable by construction -- HPACWriterCapability is process-local, single-use, non-serializable). Adversarial replay against the now-live production installation was NOT attempted (would require a second production mutation, explicitly out of scope this phase); deferred to the successor deployment-state IV per phase rule 22.
